text: athena check --history now rejects commit 64ecdc9 ('the Athena-Job trailer names 20261010-132713-ezm8, but the commit adds the records of 20261010-131714-adcd'); make it pass on our real history, and make a gate change unable to land as verified while the candidate's own gate fails the history check. A first try was rejected because: it ran the old compiled-in gate, not the candidate's; it never found why that commit carries another job's records; its acceptance command didn't run; it exempted 64ecdc9 by a 7-character prefix.
